manual.title: User manual
manual.subtitle: Quick guide to the Clínica Tanah CRM — modules, roles, and main workflows.
manual.start_body: The CRM is trilingual (PT / ES / EN) and multi-clinic. Use the sidebar to navigate. On small screens, open the menu from the top bar.
manual.start_step1: Sign in with your email and password.
manual.start_step2: Check the active clinic in the header (superadmins can switch under Clinics).
manual.start_step3: Pick the language in the sidebar footer (PT, ES, or EN).
manual.start_step4: Start on the Dashboard for today’s overview, then open the module you need.
manual.roles_intro: Access depends on the user’s role. Menus and actions change accordingly.
manual.mod_dashboard_purpose: Day overview: appointments, patients, stock, invoices, LGPD.
manual.mod_dashboard_how: Open after login. Use the cards to prioritise follow-ups.
manual.mod_patients_purpose: Full patient record (clinical ID, contact, LGPD consent).
manual.mod_patients_how: CRM-style list: views, filters and search. Click a name for the record (properties, timeline, associations). Create patient from the top-right.
manual.mod_appointments_purpose: Clinic schedule: book, confirm, cancel, no-show.
manual.mod_appointments_how: New appointment → patient + practitioner + time → Save. Update status through the day.
manual.mod_encounters_how: Create an encounter for the patient (link appointment if any). Record the visit.
manual.mod_prescriptions_how: New prescription → patient / meds → Save. Doctors write; staff can view.
manual.mod_inventory_how: Register items, receive batches, record usage. Watch low stock and expiry alerts.
manual.mod_accounting_purpose: Chart of accounts and journal entries.
manual.mod_accounting_how: Maintain accounts and post balanced debit/credit entries.
manual.mod_invoices_how: New invoice → optionally upload NF/receipt for NVIDIA OCR → review lines → Save. Attach more docs from the open invoice.
manual.mod_payroll_how: Add employees, run the period, approve, then pay.
manual.mod_whatsapp_purpose: Inbox, campaigns, templates, automations, audience, NPS.
manual.mod_whatsapp_how: Use Chats daily; Campaigns/Automations for outreach; honour LGPD opt-out.
manual.mod_lgpd_how: Capture consent on intake; fulfil access/erasure requests in LGPD.
manual.mod_team_how: New user → email, password, role → Save. Prefer deactivate over delete when history exists.
manual.mod_settings_how: Update clinic details and mint API tokens for integrations.
manual.mod_clinics_how: Create a clinic with an initial admin; switch context to operate another unit.
manual.role_admin_access: Broad access: team, settings, marketing, finance, operations.
manual.role_doctor_access: Patients, schedule, encounters, prescriptions; operational WhatsApp send.
manual.role_receptionist_access: Patients, schedule, invoices, WhatsApp/marketing, LGPD requests.
manual.role_superadmin_access: Everything an admin has, plus multi-clinic management.
manual.patients_body: Every patient should have LGPD consent recorded for lawful processing and messaging.
manual.patients_step2: Fill identity (name, birth date, CPF) and contact (WhatsApp as +55…).
manual.patients_step3: Tick LGPD consent and complete sociodemographic fields when available.
manual.patients_step4: Save. Use search to edit or open related clinical records.
manual.appointments_body: Appointments can come from reception or the WhatsApp bot. Status drives the daily flow.
manual.appointments_step2: Pick patient, practitioner, type, and available slot.
manual.appointments_step3: Confirm on the day; mark arrived / in progress / completed as care proceeds.
manual.appointments_step4: Use cancelled or no-show when needed — that feeds follow-up automations.
manual.clinical_body: In the patient workspace (Clinical tab): anamnesis, daily evolutions, SOAP, vitals, exams, procedures, problem list, allergies, prescriptions, attachments, and Body (capture/measurements/scenarios). CFM 20-year retention; each note carries a professional stamp (name + council/UF).
manual.clinical_step1: Open patient → Clinical → record anamnesis, evolution, or SOAP with stamp.
manual.clinical_step2: Keep allergies and problems current; order exams and register results; use Body for anthropometry and scenarios.
manual.clinical_step3: Do not delete patients with clinical history — use the LGPD flow. Voids stay in the retention archive.
manual.inventory_body: Batch and expiry tracking prevents stockouts and waste.
manual.inventory_step1: Register the item (name, unit, minimum stock).
manual.inventory_step2: Receive stock by batch with expiry; record usage/out movements.
manual.inventory_step3: Keep Vendors up to date for replenishment.
manual.finance_body: Typical flow: care → invoice → receive → book; payroll runs by period.
manual.finance_step1: Create Invoices with line items; link the patient when relevant.
manual.finance_step2: Mark paid on receipt; watch pending items on the Dashboard.
manual.finance_step3: Post Accounting entries with matching debits and credits.
manual.finance_step4: In Payroll: employees → run period → approve → pay.
manual.marketing_body: Full hub: inbox, segmented campaigns, Meta-style templates, automations, and analytics. Only consented non-opted-out contacts are messaged.
manual.marketing_step1: Chats: serve patients or use the dry-run simulator.
manual.marketing_step2: Templates: create/approve marketing or utility copy with {{name}}.
manual.marketing_step3: Campaigns: pick a segment (consented, inactive, birthdays…) and dispatch.
manual.marketing_step4: Automations: enable 24h/2h reminders, NPS, welcome, etc., and run when needed.
manual.marketing_step5: Audience & Analytics: inspect segment sizes and last-30-day performance.
manual.lgpd_body: The CRM stores consent, marketing opt-out, and data-subject requests with an audit trail.
manual.lgpd_step1: Always capture consent when registering a patient.
manual.lgpd_step2: For access, correction, or erasure requests, open LGPD and fulfil them.
manual.lgpd_step3: Promo messages include an opt-out footer; SAIR/STOP stops campaigns.
manual.admin_body: Admins manage users and preferences; superadmins manage multiple clinics.
manual.admin_step1: In Team, create users with the right role and a strong password.
manual.admin_step2: In Settings, update clinic data and API tokens if integrating systems.
manual.admin_step3: In Clinics (superadmin), add units and switch working context.
manual.tip1: Sessions last up to 24 hours; if you see “session expired”, sign in again.
manual.tip2: WhatsApp numbers need the country code (+55…) for the bot and campaigns.
manual.tip3: The Dashboard highlights low stock, expiring batches, and pending invoices.
manual.tip4: Install the PWA on phone or Windows from the browser for quick access.
manual.tip5: Come back to this Manual anytime — the contents jump to each section.
manual.howto_intro: Complete, step-by-step instructions for how to perform every task in the system. Button names may vary by language and by the user's role.

howto.title: Sign in (login)
steps: Open the browser and go to the system address (the link provided by the clinic).
On the login screen, click the "Email" field and type your email.
Click the "Password" field and type your password; use the eye icon to reveal it if needed.
Click the "Sign in" button.
If you see "invalid email or password", check the details and try again (after many attempts access is locked for 15 minutes).
Once in, check the active clinic at the top and start from the Dashboard.

howto.title: Choose the language (PT / ES / EN)
steps: Find the language buttons at the bottom of the left sidebar.
Click PT, ES or EN for the language you want.
The interface changes instantly and the preference is saved in the browser for next time.

howto.title: Switch the active clinic (superadmin only)
steps: Open "Clinics" in the sidebar.
Find the clinic you want to work with in the list.
Select it to make it the active clinic (or use the selector at the top of the screen).
Confirm the active clinic name in the header before creating or editing data.

howto.title: Register a new patient
steps: Open "Patients" in the sidebar.
Click "+ New Patient" in the top-right corner.
Under Identification, fill in Full name, Date of birth and CPF.
Under Contact, fill in the Phone in +55AREA-NUMBER format (required for WhatsApp) and the email.
Fill in the Address (ZIP code, street, number, neighborhood, city and state) when available.
Fill in health and sociodemographic data (insurance, blood type, allergies, conditions and medications) as applicable.
Tick the LGPD Consent checkbox — it is required to save.
Click "Save". The patient now appears in the list.

howto.title: Search, edit or delete a patient
steps: Open "Patients" and type a name, phone, email or CPF in the search box.
Use the "Insurance" filter to narrow by health plan, or choose "No insurance".
To edit, click the pencil icon on the patient's row, adjust the fields and click "Save".
To delete, click the trash icon and confirm on "Delete".
Note: patients with clinical records cannot be deleted — use the LGPD flow when needed.

howto.title: Schedule an appointment
steps: Open "Appointments" in the sidebar.
Click "+ New Appointment".
In the "Patient" field, click and select the patient from the list (or type to search).
In the "Practitioner" field, select the responsible doctor or professional.
In "Date and time", choose the date and time; if available slots appear, click one of the green buttons.
Adjust the type and duration if needed (default is 30 minutes).
Click "Save". The appointment now appears on the calendar.

howto.title: Update an appointment's status
steps: Open "Appointments" and find the appointment on the calendar.
Open the appointment and change the status along the flow: confirmed, arrived, in progress or completed.
Use "cancelled" or "no-show" when the patient does not attend.
Save. No-show/cancelled statuses feed the follow-up automations.

howto.title: Record an encounter (SOAP note)
steps: Open "Encounters" in the sidebar.
Create a new encounter and link it to the patient (and the appointment, if any).
Fill in the S (subjective), O (objective), A (assessment) and P (plan) fields.
Add ICD-10 diagnosis codes when applicable.
Save the encounter. Do not delete patients with clinical history.

howto.title: Issue a prescription
steps: Open "Prescriptions" in the sidebar.
Create a new prescription linked to the patient (and the encounter, if any).
Add each medication with dosage, frequency, duration and instructions.
Save. When available, the prescription can be generated as PDF and sent via WhatsApp.

howto.title: Add an inventory item, batch and movement
steps: Open "Inventory" in the sidebar.
Add the item with its name, unit, category and minimum stock.
Register a batch with batch number, expiry date and quantity.
Record outflows/usage as the item is consumed.
Track low-stock and expiring-batch alerts from the Dashboard.

howto.title: Add a vendor
steps: Open "Vendors" in the sidebar.
Click "+ New vendor".
Fill in the legal name and CNPJ (required), plus the contact details.
Click "Save".

howto.title: Issue an invoice
steps: Open "Invoices" in the sidebar.
Create a new invoice and link it to the patient when applicable.
Add the line items and amounts and review the total.
Click "Save". Mark the invoice as paid when received; pending ones appear on the Dashboard.

howto.title: Run payroll
steps: Open "Payroll" in the sidebar.
Add or update the employees.
Run the payroll for the desired period (month).
Review the INSS, IRRF and FGTS amounts, approve and record the payment.

howto.title: Handle conversations and use the WhatsApp simulator
steps: Open "Marketing" (WhatsApp) in the sidebar.
Under "Conversations", select a number to see the history and reply.
Without Meta credentials, sending stays in simulation (dry-run) mode and nothing leaves the server.
Use the simulator to test the bot flow as if you were the patient.

howto.title: Create a template, campaign and automation
steps: Under "Templates", create or edit a message using {{name}} and set the category (marketing or utility).
Under "Campaigns", choose the segment (consented, inactive, birthdays…) and send the blast.
Under "Automations", enable 24h/2h reminders, NPS, welcome and others, and run them whenever you want.
Respect opt-out: anyone replying STOP/SAIR stops receiving campaigns.

howto.title: Record consent and handle LGPD requests
steps: Record LGPD consent on the patient's record when creating or editing it.
Open "LGPD" in the sidebar to see consents, opt-outs and the audit trail.
When you receive an access, rectification or deletion request, open a data-subject request.
Fulfil the request and record the response; everything is stored in the audit log.

howto.title: Create a team user (admin)
steps: Open "Team" in the sidebar.
Click "+ New user".
Fill in email, a strong password and choose the role (doctor, reception, etc.).
Click "Save". Prefer deactivating rather than deleting when there is history.

howto.title: Generate an API token (admin)
steps: Open "Settings" in the sidebar.
In the API tokens section, click to generate a new token.
Set the name, the scope (read or read/write) and the expiry.
Copy the displayed token — it is shown only once — and store it securely.

howto.title: Create and switch clinics (superadmin)
steps: Open "Clinics" in the sidebar.
Click to create a new clinic and set the initial admin.
Use the top selector to switch the working context between clinics.

howto.title: Save a shortcut in the Apps module
steps: Open "Apps" in the sidebar.
Type a name in the "Name" field and the address in the "URL" field (https:// is added automatically if missing).
Click "+ Add"; the shortcut appears as a card.
Click the card to open the site in a new tab; use the trash icon and confirm on "Delete" to remove it.

howto.title: Install the app (PWA)
steps: In the browser (mobile or Windows), open the browser menu.
Choose "Install app" or "Add to home screen".
Confirm; the app then opens in its own window for quick access.

body.purpose: Clinical purpose: care record and professionally mediated scenario visualization — not autonomous diagnosis.
body.bmi_note: *BMI is contextual; do not use it as the sole eligibility gate.
body.urgent: Seek immediate medical care or emergency services. This app does not triage emergencies.
body.simulations_blocked: New simulations were blocked. Records that must be retained for legal or care obligations may remain protected.
body.meds_disclaimer: Record only medications in use or prescribed. The app does not recommend starting, switching, or adjusting doses.
body.capture_hint: Standardized clinical front photo for body composition and illustrative scenarios. Requires image-processing consent.
body.scenario_notice: This image illustrates a possible scenario based on recorded assumptions. Not a prediction or outcome guarantee.
body.consent_required: Clinical record and image-processing consents are required.
body.capture_subtitle: Front, left, right and back · EXIF GPS removed on server · immutable originals
body.public_export_blocked: Clinical images and simulations cannot be published through this flow.
body.capture_pose_hint: Gallery or camera. Pose: arms 10–15 cm from torso, neutral head.
body.capture_invalid_type: Upload images only (JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC).
body.capture_too_large: File exceeds 8MB. Reduce resolution and try again.
body.capture_heic_hint: Could not read this photo. On iPhone, use Take photo or send as JPEG.
body.capture_delete_confirm: Remove the {{view}} photo from the active chart?
body.capture_delete_all_confirm: Remove all photos in this session from the active chart?
body.capture_delete_retention: This is a logical delete: the file stays in the clinical archive (CFM/LGPD retention) and audit log — it is not wiped from storage.
body.capture_deleted: {{view}} photo removed from the active chart (file retained).
body.capture_session_deleted: Session removed from the active chart (files retained).
body.capture_new_session_hint: Start a new session to capture replacement photos. Validated sessions and logically deleted files remain in the clinical archive.
body.meas_intro: Full set for consultation: circumferences, body composition, vitals and measurement context.
body.meas_optional_hint: Empty fields are optional. Height and weight are required.
body.meas_indices_note: *BMI, WHR and WHtR are contextual measures — never the sole eligibility gate.
body.life_intro: Neutral language: check-in, trend, scenario — no “failure” or “perfect body”.
body.life_scope_banner: Calories, deficit, and training feed the composition engine (RAG + energy balance) used for the “after” simulation. Illustrative only — not a clinical promise.
body.sim_intro: Explore hypothetical body changes with clinical medication, nutrition, training, sleep, hydration and lifestyle plans — side by side with the standardized photograph.
body.sim_audience: For wellness clinics, weight management, dietitians, exercise professionals and patients — visual goal communication, without replacing medical assessment.
body.sim_disclaimer: Every generated image is an illustrative simulation — not a guaranteed result or medical prediction. Real outcomes vary with genetics, health conditions, treatment response, adherence, dose, nutrition, training intensity and other individual factors.
body.sim_flow: Front/side/back capture → configure interventions and adherence → compute if/then envelope → generate illustrative simulation → clinical review.
body.step_up_hint: Re-authentication is required to generate illustrative clinical images.
body.inspector_sync_note: Zoom is illustrative — real sync zoom is not required in this version.
body.library_search_ph: Search by name, ingredient or class…
body.library_select_placeholder: Or choose from the full list…
body.library_empty: No medications found. Try another term.
body.library_load_failed: Could not load the medication library.
body.partial_gen_hint: Generation works with 1–4 photos: after-images are created only for captured views. A full set improves the contact sheet.
body.sim_generate_panel_hint: Uses captured photos (1–4 views). Confirm your password and generate the illustrative before/after.
body.sim_configure_below: Tune interventions and horizon below (optional before generating).
body.full_report_intro: Generate a full clinical dossier from the patient history and clinic processes (chart + Body).
body.full_report_hint: Includes demographics, alerts, consents, measurements, medications, lifestyle, captures, scenarios, SOAP/evolutions/exams and schedule. Authenticated document — not public.
body.full_report_sig_required: Enter a clinical signature to generate the report.

chart.cfm_notice: Electronic chart aligned with CFM 1.638/2002. Every evolution and encounter carries professional identification (name + council/UF). Clinical retention: 20 years (CFM 1.821/2007). Identification stamp — not ICP-Brasil NGS2 digital signature.
chart.anamnese_hint: A new anamnesis version is stamped; prior versions remain.
chart.evol_hint: Daily evolution with professional identification (CFM required).
chart.soap_hint: SOAP encounter for this patient. Full list under
chart.rx_hint: Prescriptions for this patient. Issue new ones under
chart.attach_hint: Record references to labs, imaging and clinical documents (metadata + retention).

privacy.intro: This policy explains how Clínica Tanah processes personal and health data under Brazil's LGPD (Law 13.709/2018) and CFM clinical record retention (Res. 1.821/2007).
